pipeline_steps.technique: Identification of spatially tuned cells via tuning specificity and spatial information

parameters.running_epoch_definition: consecutive forward-locomotion frames >=1 s duration with peak speed >=5 cm/s; epochs separated by <0.5 s merged
parameters.tuning_specificity: magnitude of the spatial tuning vector (1 - circular variance of occupancy-normalized transients); significance via 100,000 shuffles of transient onset times within running frames
parameters.spatial_information: Skaggs spatial information content computed across bin counts N = {2,4,5,8,10,20,25,100}; bias-corrected against 100,000 shuffled-onset null distributions
parameters.classification: cells classified as place cells separately by each metric based on shuffle-derived p-values

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: Ca2+ transient onset times restricted to running epochs
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: classified place cells with tuning specificity and spatial information scores

pipeline_steps.technique: Cross-session remapping analysis: population vector correlation, centroid shift, and tuning curve correlation

parameters.rate_maps: 100 position bins, Gaussian-smoothed (σ = 3 bins), transients per bin normalized by occupancy
parameters.pv_correlation: 1D rate maps of all cells per sublayer stacked into population vectors, all cells included regardless of tuning
parameters.centroid_shift: angle (radians) between spatial tuning vectors across sessions, restricted to place cells by tuning specificity
parameters.tuning_curve_correlation: Pearson correlation between rate maps across sessions, restricted to place cells by spatial information

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: cross-session rate maps and tuning vectors
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: PV correlation, centroid shift, and tuning curve correlation values

pipeline_steps.technique: Deep-vs-superficial task-modulation shuffle analysis (RF vs. GOL)

parameters.shuffle_1: null distribution of delta task modulation from randomizing deep/superficial cell identity within each experiment (100,000 shuffles)
parameters.shuffle_2: null distribution from shuffling RF/GOL experiment identity while preserving each cell's sublayer identity (100,000 shuffles)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: significance of sublayer difference in task modulation

pipeline_steps.technique: Reward-representation-versus-performance regression and shuffle analysis

parameters.regression: linear regression of GOL task performance (fraction of licks in reward zone) on covariates including day of experiment
parameters.comparison_metric: absolute difference between correlation coefficients (r-values) for the two sublayers
parameters.null_model: null distribution of r-value differences from randomizing cell identity within each experiment (100,000 shuffles)

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: per-cell reward-zone representation strength and behavioral performance
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: regression coefficients and significance of sublayer difference in reward encoding

pipeline_steps.technique: Group-level statistical testing framework

parameters.primary_test: paired two-sample t-test wherever possible to compare population means across animals
parameters.nonparametric_alternative: Mann-Whitney U test when a paired t-test was not applicable
parameters.repeated_measures: ANOVA to compare behavior across sessions and days

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: statistical significance results

pipeline_steps.technique: Operant lick-to-reward training on a single-fabric, cue-free treadmill

parameters.reward_schedule: began with 40 randomly placed rewards/lap, decreased until mice ran reliably for 3 randomly placed rewards/lap at ≥1 lap/min
parameters.reward_delivery: water delivered on tongue contact with a capacitive lick sensor at random hidden locations; delivery stopped after 10 cm past reward-zone entry or 3 s elapsed

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice trained to lick operantly for water reward

pipeline_steps.technique: Goal-oriented learning (GOL) task across three sequential reward-position conditions

parameters.reward_zone: fixed 20-cm reward zone on a 180-200 cm treadmill belt
parameters.condition_II: belt and nonspatial context changed (Context A'), reward position held constant, days 4-6
parameters.condition_III: Context A', reward zone moved to a new location, days 7-9
parameters.learning_metric: fraction of licks occurring within a spatiotemporally defined 20-cm x 3-s goal window

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: lick-position behavioral data across learning conditions

pipeline_steps.technique: Random foraging (RF) task

parameters.sessions: 2 sessions/day, either in the same context or paired contexts

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: lick-position behavioral data with no learned reward position

pipeline_steps.technique: Multisensory virtual-context construction and belt-position tracking system

parameters.context_cues: constant odor (carvone or isopentyl acetate), blinking red LED (100 ms duration at 1 Hz, or off), and either a pure tone (10 kHz) or continuous beeps (2 kHz, 100 ms at 1 Hz)
parameters.belts: 2-m belts constructed from 3 stitched fabrics with 6 adhered local tactile cues; paired contexts share fabric sequence with randomized cue order
parameters.position_tracking: 3 RFID registration anchors (16 mm, 125 kHz, SparkFun) detected by a fixed RFID reader (ID-12LA, SparkFun), interpolated using a quadrature-encoded movement signal from offset tick marks read by a paired photodiode sensor (SEN-0024, SparkFun), <0.5 cm resolution

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: multisensory virtual-context stimuli and continuous belt-position signal
pipeline_steps.hardware: RFID buttons and reader (SparkFun); photodiode quadrature encoder (SparkFun SEN-0024)

pipeline_steps.technique: Pharmacological inactivation of dorsal hippocampus via muscimol microinfusion

parameters.cannulae: bilateral 24-gauge guide cannulae implanted over dorsal CA1 (AP -1.7 mm, ML ±1.5 mm, DV -1.0 mm) with 31-gauge injection cannulae extending 0.5 mm past the guide tips
parameters.drug: GABA-A agonist muscimol (Sigma), 0.15 µL of 1 µg/µL at 0.25 µL/min, vs. 0.9% saline control
parameters.design: counterbalanced groups (saline n=4, muscimol n=3) with drug schedules reversed on day 4; injection cannulae left in place 2 min post-infusion for drug diffusion

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice with pharmacologically silenced dorsal hippocampus during behavior
pipeline_steps.hardware: Hamilton syringe and microinfusion pump (World Precision Instruments)

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon Ca2+ imaging acquisition

pipeline_steps.technique: Motion correction and ROI segmentation with SIMA

parameters.motion_correction: plane-wise implementation of a 2D hidden Markov model
parameters.segmentation: manual polygon-drawing around GCaMP6f-labeled somata on the first imaged session per field of view, along the inner cytosolic border to minimize neuropil contamination
parameters.interneuron_exclusion: putative interneurons excluded based on multipolar, larger soma morphology and higher baseline/nuclear fluorescence
parameters.cross_session_registration: ROIs registered across imaging sessions of the same field of view via SIMA's ROI Buddy GUI using a piecewise-affine transformation

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected video with registered somatic ROIs tracked across sessions

pipeline_steps.technique: ΔF/F fluorescence trace extraction
pipeline_steps.input_data_type: raw ROI fluorescence time series extracted via SIMA
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: ΔF/F traces per ROI

pipeline_steps.technique: Significant calcium-event detection via empirical false-positive-rate thresholding

parameters.event_definition: consecutive frames starting ≥2 s.d. above/below the mean, ending when the signal fell to 0.5 s.d., lasting ≥250 ms
parameters.binning: events binned by 0.5-sigma amplitude and 250-ms duration
parameters.threshold: bin retained if its empirical false-positive rate (ratio of negative to positive events) was ≤0.05

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: detected significant Ca2+ transients

pipeline_steps.technique: Selection of spatially tuned (place) cells via shuffled mutual-information analysis

parameters.running_epoch_definition: consecutive forward-locomotion frames ≥1 s duration with peak speed ≥5 cm/s; epochs separated by <0.5 s merged
parameters.metric: spatial information content computed for N = {2,4,5,10,20,25,50,100} position bins
parameters.null_distribution: 1,000 shuffles of transient onset times within running epochs, with bias correction by subtracting the shuffle-distribution mean
parameters.classification: cells in the top 5% of their shuffle distribution classified as place cells

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: Ca2+ transient onset times restricted to running epochs
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: classified place cells with spatial information scores

pipeline_steps.technique: Place-field detection and rate-map construction

parameters.rate_map: 100 position bins, Gaussian-smoothed (σ = 3 bins); transients per bin normalized by bin occupancy
parameters.field_definition: each local rate-map maximum fit with a Gaussian; overlapping fields merged; fields with area <50% of the largest discarded

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: spatially-binned Ca2+ transient rates for place cells
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: place fields and rate maps

pipeline_steps.technique: Place-cell tuning-property metrics

parameters.spatial_tuning_vector: circular mean resultant vector of transient onset positions, weighted by occupancy
parameters.circular_variance: 1 minus the magnitude of the spatial tuning vector
parameters.transient_sensitivity_specificity: sensitivity = fraction of laps with a significant transient in the place field; specificity = fraction of transients occurring within the field
parameters.sparsity: single-cell sparsity computed from per-bin transient rates
parameters.lifetime_place_coding: fraction of all cells ever classified as a place cell by the nth imaged session

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: place fields and per-cell transient data
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-cell tuning-property metric values

pipeline_steps.technique: Remapping analysis: recurrence probability and place-field centroid shift

parameters.recurrence_probability: fraction of place cells identified in one experiment that were also place cells in a paired experiment
parameters.centroid_shift: distance between spatial tuning vectors for a cell across a session pair, normalized to belt length, range [-0.5, 0.5)
parameters.inclusion_criterion: cell required to have fired ≥1 transient in both compared experiments

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: spatial tuning vectors across paired imaging sessions
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: recurrence probabilities and centroid-shift distributions

pipeline_steps.technique: Cueness metric for cue-preferring vs. place-preferring cell classification

parameters.definition: c = dp / (dp + dc), where dp is centroid distance to the pre-cue-shift cue position and dc is centroid distance to the post-cue-shift cue position
parameters.classification: cueness > 0.67 classified as cue-preferring; cueness < 0.33 classified as place-preferring

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: place-field centroids around a local-cue shift
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: cue-preferring vs. place-preferring cell classifications

pipeline_steps.technique: Shuffle-distribution generation for recurrence, centroid-shift, and cueness null models

parameters.recurrence_shuffle: chance-level recurrence pooled across all experiment pairs and both genotypes
parameters.centroid_cueness_shuffle: 10,000 randomly paired activity centroids drawn from correctly paired experiments with cell identity ignored

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: null distributions for recurrence, centroid shift, and cueness

pipeline_steps.technique: Position-dependent recurrence and stability modeling via cyclic cubic splines

parameters.model: nonparametric logistic regression fitting a cyclic cubic spline to place-cell recurrence (1/0) as a function of distance from the reward location
parameters.regularization: smoothness penalty selected by leave-one-out cross-validation

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: Condition III session data (the condition showing remapping toward the reward)
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: position-dependent recurrence and stability curves with confidence intervals

pipeline_steps.technique: Computational simulation of goal-directed place-field remapping dynamics

parameters.model: iterative simulation drawing new place-field positions from a von Mises distribution with position-dependent offset µ(x) and concentration κ(x), each fit as a cyclic cubic spline via leave-one-out cross-validation
parameters.activation_rate: fixed fraction of non-place cells become spatially active per iteration (Pon: WT 24.83%, Df(16)A+/- 20.58%)
parameters.simulation_design: 8 iterations per run (matching 8 observed session-to-session transitions), 100 simulations per condition
parameters.parameter_swap_analysis: individual fitted parameters swapped between WT and flat-model fits to assess their contribution to place-field enrichment near the reward

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: fitted recurrence/shift model parameters from WT and Df(16)A+/- data
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: simulated place-field enrichment/recurrence trajectories

pipeline_steps.technique: LFP acquisition and sharp-wave ripple (SWR) detection

parameters.acquisition: 4-channel silicon probe (NeuroNexus) centered on stratum pyramidale, 25 kHz digital acquisition (Intan Technologies), 20-min head-fixed recordings on a cue-free treadmill with randomly distributed water rewards
parameters.preprocessing: bandpass filtered 0.1-625 Hz and downsampled to 1,250 Hz; recording site chosen by ripple-band amplitude and location dorsal to stratum radiatum sharp-waves
parameters.inclusion: only immobile epochs (velocity < 3 cm/s) free of muscle-related artifact
parameters.spectrogram: Gabor wavelet spectrograms computed 1-250 Hz, power z-scored within session
parameters.ripple_detection: pyramidal-layer LFP bandpass filtered 125-250 Hz, rectified, smoothed with a 25-ms s.d. Gaussian kernel, z-scored; trigger peaks ≥6 s.d. above the mean with edges at 2 s.d., candidate events within 30 ms of each other merged, minimum event duration 30 ms

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: detected sharp-wave ripple events and incidence rates
pipeline_steps.hardware: NeuroNexus 4-channel silicon probe; Intan Technologies digital acquisition system

pipeline_steps.technique: Group-level statistical testing framework

parameters.behavioral_comparisons: linear mixed-effects model or mixed-design repeated-measures two-way ANOVA
parameters.distribution_checks: Levene's test for equal variance; Kolmogorov-Smirnov test for normality
parameters.two_group_comparisons: two-sample unpaired t-test, or Welch's t-test / Mann-Whitney U test when variance/normality assumptions were violated
parameters.other_tests: Wilcoxon rank-sum test (for SWR genotype comparisons), Chi-squared test, Cox regression, or two-way mixed-effects ANOVA for other parameter comparisons
parameters.correlation: Pearson correlation / linear regression; GLM after z-score transformation for between-group correlation comparisons

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: statistical significance results
